cli.title: AI Novelist CLI
cli.option.init: Initialize the novel workspace and create novel/Novel_Overview.md.
cli.option.plan: Generate a guide for a chapter.
cli.option.scan: Scan a chapter and commit extracted facts.
cli.option.auto: Generate COUNT chapters beginning at START_CHAPTER.
cli.option.conflicts_json: List pending conflicts as diagnostic JSON.
cli.option.conflicts_triage: List pending conflicts with triage recommendations.
cli.option.level: Filter conflict output by blocking level.
cli.option.resolve_conflict: Resolve one conflict with keep_existing or apply_incoming.
cli.option.resolve_note: Attach a note to conflict resolution.
cli.option.replay_bulk: Preview or replay failed commits in bulk.
cli.option.replay_dry_run: Validate bulk replay candidates without writing.
cli.option.replay_limit: Maximum failed commits included in bulk replay.
cli.option.triage_batch: Resolve up to LIMIT non-blocking conflicts with keep_existing.
cli.option.rebuild_vectors: Rebuild FAISS deterministically from SQLite metadata.
cli.option.ai_resolve: Allow the ATT conflict committee to resolve blocking conflicts.
cli.bulk.title: Bulk Commit Replay Report
template.novel_overview:
# Novel Overview

Write your high-level novel setup here.

This file should contain only your requirements for the novel project.
The system will read the full document as input.

Include at least:

* Genre and tone
* Main characters and core relationships
* World constraints and major rules
* Initial conflict and rough long arc
